drive_storage_bytes.label: Drive Storage (bytes)
drive_storage_bytes.description: Total Drive storage per member. 0 disables uploads.

drive_max_file_bytes.label: Drive Max File Size (bytes)
drive_max_file_bytes.description: Largest single file a member may upload to Drive. 0 disables uploads.

drive_share_links.label: Drive Share Links
drive_share_links.description: Allow members to mint public share links for Drive files and folders.

drive_versioning_depth.label: Drive Versions Kept
drive_versioning_depth.description: How many prior versions of each Drive file to retain. 0 keeps only the current version.
